summary.text: Tony Micklus, listed by Ballotpedia as Anthony Micklus, is a Republican state representative from the Chittenden-Franklin district who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He has worked in real estate and information technology.

paragraphs.text: Tony Micklus was born in Coldwater, Michigan, and earned a bachelor's degree from Champlain College.
His career experience includes working in real estate and information technology.
Micklus assumed office on January 8, 2025, and advanced from the Republican primary on August 11, 2026.
